industry_and_segment: B2B Buyer Intelligence Platform, AI-Powered Sales Intelligence, Technographic Prospecting
key_positioning: AI-powered B2B buyer intelligence platform focused on precision over volume, combining technographic analysis, machine learning enrichment, and real-time market signals to help B2B sales and marketing teams find, qualify, and reach best-fit accounts. Pay only for what you reveal.
revenue_model: Credit-based pricing model where users pay credits to reveal company profiles and contact details. Subscription plans offer recurring monthly credits, and one-time top-up credits are available and do not expire.
pricing_tiers: Free: $0/month – 200 signup credits, basic exports, saved lists.
Starter: $49/month – 1,000 monthly credits, unlimited saved searches, CSV export history.
Pro: $99/month – 2,500 monthly credits, unlimited saved searches, CSV export history, priority support.
Growth: $199/month – 5,000 monthly credits + 500 bonus credits, priority support, advanced activity analytics, CSV export history.
Scale: $499/month – 15,000 monthly credits + 1,000 bonus credits, priority support, advanced activity analytics, dedicated account manager.
Max: $999/month – 20,000 monthly credits + 5,000 bonus credits, priority support, advanced activity analytics, dedicated account manager.
Enterprise: Custom – Custom volume, dedicated support, account-based onboarding, custom integrations.
tech_stack_highlights: AI and Machine Learning (ML) enrichment for firmographic and technographic data.
Public Web Intelligence Layer for continuous crawling, indexing, and analysis of public company data.
Semantic Search & Retrieval using vector search for instant company profile retrieval.
Real-Time Processing Pipelines for continuous data point processing.
API for programmatic access to company search, reveal, and export workflows.
new_features_launched: Natural Language Business Intelligence (Coming Soon) – Conversational AI assistant for natural language interaction with business intelligence.

differentiators.feature: Precision over volume pricing model, allowing users to pay only for revealed company profiles and contact details, avoiding wasted spend on unused data.
effect: Reduces unnecessary expenditure on large, often unused, data subscriptions.
Provides access to precise company intelligence rather than a massive contact database.

differentiators.feature: Niche-deep coverage in specific verticals like Hospitality, Healthcare, Real Estate, Travel, and Entertainment, where generic tools offer shallow data.
effect: Enables targeting companies running specific tools in their stack, improving conversion rates.
Offers deeper insights and real-time enrichment tailored to vertical needs.

differentiators.feature: AI-powered buyer intelligence combining technographic analysis, machine learning enrichment, and human-verified accuracy for better targeting.
effect: Helps teams find, qualify, and reach best-fit accounts with confidence.
Provides AI-assisted insights that are actionable and precise.

other_crucial_details: PrimoDato was founded by revenue operations professionals aiming to solve frustration with expensive, underutilized data subscriptions.
The company's team is distributed across the US, EU, and India.
Their mission is to provide AI-powered buyer intelligence to all B2B sales and marketing teams, not exclusively enterprises with large budgets.

strategic_moves.move: Development and upcoming launch of 'Natural Language Business Intelligence' or 'AI Research Assistant' for conversational AI interaction with business data.
effect: Enables faster discovery of companies, technologies, and insights using plain English.
Offers AI company insights and smart recommendations for prospecting.

strategic_moves.move: Strategic focus on providing deep data coverage and tailored solutions for specific vertical workflows, notably Hospitality, Real Estate, Travel, and Entertainment.
effect: Allows PrimoDato to serve niche markets effectively where competitors are too broad.
Attracts teams seeking specialized technographic prospecting capabilities.

strategic_moves.move: Actively seeking partnerships for CRM integrations, reseller agreements, data licensing, and API white-label inquiries.
effect: Expands market reach and integration capabilities for users.
Potentially creates new revenue streams and strengthens ecosystem presence.
